test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of these is NOT a parameter in the Ease of Doing Business (EoDB) index?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Military spending**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ease of Doing Business (EoDB)** index was an influential annual report published by the **World Bank Group** that ranked **190 economies** based on how easy it was for local firms to conduct business.
 
• The index measured business regulations across **10 specific parameters**: Starting a Business, Dealing with Construction Permits, **Getting Electricity**, Registering Property, Getting Credit, Protecting Minority Investors, **Paying Taxes**, Trading across Borders, Enforcing Contracts, and Resolving Insolvency.
 
• **Starting a business** is a core parameter that tracks the number of procedures, time, cost, and paid-in minimum capital required for a small-to-medium-sized enterprise to begin operations.
 
• **Military spending** refers to the financial resources allocated by a nation to maintain its armed forces and national security; this is a **macroeconomic/defense metric** and does not relate to the regulatory efficiency of the business environment.
 
• While the **World Bank** discontinued the **Doing Business** report in **September 2021** due to data irregularities, the parameters remain significant for studying global economic competitiveness.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Starting a business**:
 
 
• Focuses on the bureaucratic hurdles faced by entrepreneurs during the pre-incorporation and incorporation phases.
 
 
 
• **Getting electricity**:
 
 
• Measures the procedures, time, and cost to obtain a permanent commercial electricity connection for a newly constructed warehouse.
 
 
 
• **Paying taxes**:
 
 
• Evaluates the **Total Tax Rate**, the number of payments per year, and the hours spent complying with tax laws, including VAT and corporate income tax.
 
 
 
• The **World Bank** has introduced a new benchmarking tool called **Business Ready (B-READY)** to replace the legacy EoDB index, emphasizing **digitalization** and **sustainability**.
